canonical_title: Fire protection of structure, controls, and other parts

versions.title_at_revision: Fire protection of structure, controls, and other parts
versions.text:
Each part of the structure, controls, and the rotor mechanism, and other parts essential to controlled landing and (for Category A) flight that would be affected by powerplant fires m ust be isolated under CS 29. 1191, or must be:
(a) For Category A rotorcraft, fire-proof; and
(b) For Category B rotorcraft, fire-proof or protected so that they can perform their essential functions for at least 5 minutes under any foreseeable powerplant fire conditions.
